audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer's chart read Orianna / Orianna / Skill / Skill / Skill / Skill / Orianna against the content layer's and packet's Diana / Diana / Orianna / Diana / Diana / Diana / Diana.
audit.why: Level 3 is hers on the numbers: Command: Attack is down to 5s at rank 3 and a parked ball denies the approach line, while Lunar Rush costs 18s without a Moonlight mark. Every other row is Diana's on the packet and win[].
audit.corrected: Sides aligned to the content layer with each moved row's why rewritten in the same proposal.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes attributed shields to 'Command: Dissonance'. Dissonance (W) is the damage pulse plus speed/slow field on a flat 7s; the shield is Command: Protect (E), a flat 9s that also grants Armor and Magic Resist.
audit.why: Riot's text for both abilities. Which one is up decides whether your burst lands or is absorbed.
audit.corrected: Her defensive spike is Command: Protect's flat 9s shield; yours are Lunar Rush at 3, Moonfall at 6 (100/90/80) and first item.

audit.whatIsWrong: The cooldowns field named the ultimate as 'matchup-defining' without a single number, and never stated what Command: Shockwave actually does to Diana.
audit.why: Shockwave launches enemies toward the ball from 410 — it does not pull them to Orianna. That means the ball's position, not hers, sets the danger zone, and it is why a markless Lunar Rush (14s at rank 5) into the ball is the losing commit.
audit.corrected: Track the ball as a second enemy: R is 110/95/80 at 410 around the ball, Q falls to 3s at rank 5, W and E are flat 7s and 9s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two Do's/Don'ts bodies were the tradeGood and tradeBad strings pasted under unrelated titles.
audit.why: The title promised ball-timing and all-in timing; the body repeated the trade lines.
audit.corrected: Bodies rewritten to the titles they sit under, grounded in her flat 7s W and the 410 Shockwave radius.

audit.why: 55.46% over 1226 games is consistent with the 7/10 TRICKY framing.
